In exercise of powers conferred under Clause-I of Part-I of 6th Schedule to the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001. The
Commissioner Inland Revenue, Zone-I, Corporate Tax Office Lahore do hereby accord provisional recognition to the
employee’s provident fund of M/S ZAMEEN DEVELOPMENTS PRIVATE LIMITED EMPLOYEES PROVIDENT FUND
NTN 8253416 instituted by said concern.
The taxpayer has registration certificate of Punjab Trust Act 2020 from Director Land Record Punjab. The undersigned
is of the view that the l recognition of employees Provident Fund Trust may be granted to taxpayer from the date
incorporation of trust.
This recognition shall remain effective subject to the conditions specified in clause (2) of Part-I of the 6th Schedule to
the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001.

Rabia Shah
Commissioner
Inland Revenue, Zone-I
